endorsements.quote: The training should include the features used, how they operate, what their strengths and limitations are, and how the algorithms can be applied to relevant tasks.

unlisted_practices: Develop protocols for machine learning applications analogous to controlled clinical trial protocols to reduce and control statistical uncertainty.
Evaluate, quantify, and control algorithmic uncertainty, for example by constructing confidence intervals for generalization error and model uncertainty.
Assess and ensure computational reproducibility of AI algorithms using standardized workflows and computing environments.
Involve end users and AI developers in iterative collaboration to select use cases and integrate AI into the workflow.
Design tunable AI algorithms in which performance characteristics and features are selectable by the reviewer.
Document and map the cognitive framework of expert reviewers used for causal inference before automating case-based reasoning.
Provide trialability so users can try AI outputs within their workflow without total commitment.

screen.reason: This is a viewpoint article describing lessons learned and providing recommendations/frameworks for deploying, validating, and governing AI algorithms for postmarketing drug safety surveillance at the FDA.
